title: One
body:
A moment of loneliness on a balcony of a village house near Sitia, where nothing but natural sounds could be heard, was enough for me to realize that I have solemnly taken part in an eternal, global feast.

Opposite me to a pole of PPC, I observe a Samosidi silently, patiently and with absolute dedication lurking behind an unidentified insect that is heading upwards, probably looking for its evening meal.

And so, comrades, imperfect creation moves. You're always chasing something you're missing and the other person has it.

And I'm talking about the Co-Pan.

85 — m
